_comment: Templates for the event generator ('ascsync events generate').
leaderboards: metric name -> vendorIdentifier of the recurring leaderboard.
defaults: applied to every generated event. deepLink MUST be set and must
resolve — a dead link is a common reason for rejection. Leave territories
empty once pricing.json has been pulled; the generator then derives the
texts: per language. name/shortDescription/longDescription may be one string
for all metrics or an object {metric: text}. overrides.<play mode> replaces

shortDescription.score: Score as many points as you can.

longDescription.score: As many points as possible. The top 25 earn a reward.
